dairy.formula: mean of butter and cheese prices per kg milk equivalent (eggs not priced; provisional weights 0.5/0.5)

produce.formula: 0.8 potatoes + 0.2 beans per kg (60 lb bushels; provisional weights)

coffee-tea-cocoa.formula: 0.8 coffee (cocoa priced as coffee) + 0.2 tea per kg (weights by 1900 world output, provisional)

tobacco.formula: leaf tobacco export price per kg

rubber.formula: Para rubber, fine, New York, per kg

coal.formula: bituminous coal spot value per metric ton

crude-oil.formula: petroleum spot value per barrel x 7.33 barrels per t

natural-gas.formula: energy parity with bituminous coal: 1,000 m3 of gas (38 GJ) = 1.41 t of coal (27 GJ/t); no 1900 volume exists (provisional)

iron-ore.formula: ore value at mines per metric ton / 0.55 Fe grade (provisional grade)

copper-ore.formula: copper price x 0.5 payable share of ore value (provisional)

nitrates.formula: price of 2,000 lb nitrogen in nitrate at Liverpool per metric ton N

uranium.formula: 1990 delivered price per lb U3O8 / 0.45359 kg / 0.848 kg U per kg U3O8, per t U

tin.formula: tin bars and pigs per t

gold.formula: statutory mint price per fine kg

kerosene.formula: refined petroleum for export per t

petrol.formula: priced as kerosene per t until the naphtha export unit value is transcribed (provisional)

fuel-oil.formula: crude price per t x 1.1 until the residuum price is transcribed (provisional)

electricity.formula: wholesale (generation) price, 1.0 cent per kWh: between bulk hydro power at Niagara (about $20 per HP-year, 0.3 cent per kWh) and central-station income per kWh sold (about 3.4 cents, mostly lighting at retail); every reference price is wholesale. chemicals.formula: 0.6 sulphuric acid + 0.2 muriatic acid + 0.2 alum per t (provisional weights)

fertiliser.formula: nitrogen in nitrate at Liverpool per t N (provisional: fertiliser nutrient priced as nitrate N)

plastics.formula: provisional placeholder: 1990 US plastics resins about $0.60/lb; transcription pending

construction-materials.formula: 0.2 Portland cement + 0.8 common brick per t (weights by tonnage, provisional)

electrical-equipment.formula: 0.4 t copper + 0.7 t steel per t at 35 % materials share (provisional)

motor-vehicles.formula: 1990 import unit value of new passenger cars (customs value; no factory value per vehicle in the abstract)

ships.formula: about GBP 8 per gross ton for a 1900 cargo steamer (secondary; provisional)
